players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22. Earlier: He is officially questionable (foot, right thumb) for Sunday's Nov. 22 game at Detroit after limited practices Thursday and Friday. Ian Rapoport reports he will play, and Tom Pelissero says he is good to go barring a setback.

players.name: Joe Burrow
players.note: He practiced fully Thursday through Saturday (Nov. 19-21) through an illness and carries no injury designation for Monday's Nov. 23 game vs. Washington. Asked if he'd play, he said "for sure."

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: He is out for Week 11 vs. San Francisco with a Grade 2 hamstring strain, and Kirk Cousins starts again. Pelissero reported Nov. 14 that Murray could be targeting Week 12 vs. Atlanta.

players.name: Kirk Cousins
players.note: He starts Week 11 vs. San Francisco with Kyler Murray (hamstring) ruled out. Murray is targeting Week 12, so this may be a one-week streaming role.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: Arizona ruled him out (back spasms) for Sunday's Nov. 22 game at Kansas City, and 40-year-old Josh Johnson will start. Mike LaFleur doesn't think Beck will miss multiple weeks but is unsure.

players.name: Drake Maye
players.note: Schefter and Rapoport reported a fractured right ankle from the Nov. 15 game in Munich that could end his season; a later report of a fibula fracture without surgery could not be confirmed (checked Nov. 22). Tommy DeVito is set to start when New England returns from its bye.

players.name: Tommy DeVito
players.note: He is New England's starter with Drake Maye (fractured ankle, per Schefter/Rapoport) likely out deep into the season. He went 12-of-24 for 81 yards with 1 TD and 1 INT in relief in the loss to Detroit, and the Patriots return from their bye Nov. 29.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: Mike Macdonald said the team is "really optimistic" he will start Nov. 29 vs. the 49ers after the Week 11 bye, and that he remains QB1 when healthy. He missed two games with quad and rib injuries.

players.name: Drew Lock
players.note: Mike Macdonald says Sam Darnold remains the starter when healthy and is optimistic Darnold returns Nov. 29 after the bye. That likely sends Lock back to the bench despite his strong fill-in play.

players.name: Daniel Jones
players.note: Indianapolis released him on Nov. 20, and Anthony Richardson takes over as starter. He is on waivers and becomes a free agent Monday afternoon if unclaimed. Sleeper now lists him with no team (checked Nov. 22), consistent with the release.

players.name: Joe Milton
players.note: He makes his second start for Philadelphia on Sunday, Nov. 22, vs. Pittsburgh, with Jalen Hurts on IR (blood clots) and expected to miss the rest of 2026.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: He remains on IR with blood clots and is expected to miss the rest of 2026. Joe Milton is starting.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: He remains on IR after surgery on his right thumb and is likely out for the season. Jacoby Brissett is starting.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: He remains Baltimore's starter with Lamar Jackson on IR. He threw for 340 yards on Nov. 16 vs. the Chargers.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: He remains on IR and is out for the rest of the regular season after knee surgery, per NBC Sports. J.J. McCarthy is the Giants' starter.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.note: He has been on IR since Nov. 10 with a groin/core-muscle injury and is eligible to return in Week 14. Kyle McCord is starting.

players.name: Kyle McCord
players.note: He is Miami's starter while Malik Willis is on IR (placed Nov. 10, groin/core muscle). Willis can't return before Week 14.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.note: Kansas City officially ruled Walker (groin) out for Sunday's Nov. 22 game vs. Arizona. Rapoport and Schefter said there's no rush, and Thanksgiving at Buffalo looks like his most realistic return.

players.name: Emmett Johnson
players.note: With Kenneth Walker III (groin) ruled out, Johnson starts again Nov. 22 vs. Arizona, his second straight start. He had 171 yards and 2 TDs in his Nov. 15 start at Atlanta.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.note: He practiced fully all week and is listed questionable (groin). CBS's Matt Zenitz reported Nov. 21 that he is slated to come off IR in time for Monday night vs. Cincinnati, likely in a split with Rachaad White.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.note: White (heel) didn't practice Saturday, Nov. 21, and is questionable for Monday vs. Cincinnati, though Mike Garafolo said he should be good to go. Jacory Croskey-Merritt's expected return from IR points to a split backfield.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.note: Brooks practiced fully all week, but Carolina downgraded him to out on Saturday, Nov. 21, and kept him on IR (groin). His next chance to play is Week 12 vs. Tampa Bay on Nov. 30.

players.name: Chuba Hubbard
players.note: With Jonathon Brooks ruled out and kept on IR on Nov. 21, Hubbard stays Carolina's lead back for Sunday vs. Baltimore.

players.name: Kyren Williams
players.note: He was limited Saturday, Nov. 21, with a sore toe during the Rams' Week 11 bye, but Sean McVay expects him to play Wednesday vs. Green Bay. He remains in an even timeshare with Blake Corum.

players.name: Blake Corum
players.note: Corum out-carried Kyren Williams 17-12 on a 39-39 snap split in Week 10 (Nov. 15) and ran for 100 yards and a TD. With Williams nursing a sore toe ahead of Wednesday's game vs. Green Bay, Corum's committee role looks secure.

players.name: Jordan James
players.note: James (calf) is questionable for Sunday's game vs. Minnesota in Mexico City after limited practices Thursday and Friday (Nov. 19-20). His recent role has been mostly kick returns.

players.name: Cam Skattebo
players.note: Skattebo practiced fully Nov. 20, is off the injury report for Sunday vs. Jacksonville, and played a season-high 89% of snaps last week. The Athletic's Dan Duggan expects his heavy workload to continue until Tyrone Tracy Jr. returns from IR in Week 13.

players.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
players.note: Tracy (hamstring) has been on IR since Oct. 27. Dan Duggan reports he appears on track to return once eligible in Week 13.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.note: Green Bay is on its Week 11 bye. Ian Rapoport reported Nov. 17 that Jacobs (finger) has a realistic chance to return Nov. 25 vs. the Rams.

players.name: Kaleb Johnson
players.note: Green Bay is on bye in Week 11. Josh Jacobs (finger) could return Nov. 25 vs. the Rams (Rapoport, Nov. 17), which would likely end Johnson's run as the lead back.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.note: New England is on its Week 11 bye after Stevenson played through a knee issue Nov. 15, managing 6 carries for 4 yards while Corey Kiner led the backfield with 10 carries. A committee with Kiner looks likely in Week 12 vs. the Chargers.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Montgomery (groin) returned on TNF Nov. 19 vs. the Colts and handled a workhorse load: 26 carries for 107 yards plus 3 catches for 17 yards.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: Marks (concussion) sat out TNF Nov. 19 while David Montgomery returned and took 26 carries. Marks projects as the backup once he clears protocol.

players.name: Seth McGowan
players.note: McGowan's offensive role shrank to 3 carries for 7 yards and 1 catch on TNF Nov. 19 at Houston. Most of his work came on kick returns.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: The Patriots placed Henderson (illness) on IR on Nov. 14, so he will miss at least four games.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Love (high ankle sprain) has been on IR since Nov. 3 and is expected to miss 4-5 weeks.

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.note: Harvey (knee) remains on IR. Jonah Coleman is established as Denver's lead back, so Harvey's role is likely to shrink when he returns.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (ankle) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22. Earlier: Bowers (ankle/quad) is questionable for Sunday's 4:25 PM ET game at Denver after limited practices Thursday and Friday (Nov 19-20). Mike Florio reported he is expected to play, but Bowers and Klint Kubiak would not commit, so check the final inactives.

players.name: Michael Mayer
players.note: Mayer played 49 of 59 snaps in Week 10 after Bowers left. Bowers (questionable) is expected to play at Denver on Nov 22, so Mayer only gets a Week 11 boost if Bowers is inactive.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (thumb) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22. Earlier: Kincaid (thumb/ankle) did not practice all week and is doubtful for Week 11 as of Nov 21. Dawson Knox is expected to lead the Bills' TE room if Kincaid sits.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.note: Hockenson (wrist/chest) came off the injury report Friday, Nov 20, and will play in Week 11 after missing Week 10. Jordan Addison's thumb surgery could leave more targets for him.

players.name: Travis Kelce
players.note: Kelce is expected to be available in Week 11. The Chiefs placed TE Jared Wiley (ankle) on IR on Nov 18, which leaves only Noah Gray and Jake Briningstool behind him after Kelce played just 20 snaps in Week 10.

players.name: Hunter Henry
players.note: Drake Maye suffered a reported fractured ankle on Nov. 15 in Munich (Schefter/Rapoport) and could miss the rest of the season. Tommy DeVito is expected to start at QB, which lowers the ceiling for Henry and the rest of the Patriots' pass catchers.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) remains on IR through the Rams' Week 11 bye. Sean McVay said on Nov 14 that he would miss 'another couple weeks', so Week 12 vs. Green Bay is the earliest likely return.

players.name: Tyler Higbee
players.note: Higbee played 51 of 76 snaps with a TD in Week 10 and remains the Rams' lead TE while Terrance Ferguson is on IR. The Rams are on bye in Week 11 (Nov 22).

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Brown (hamstring, hurt Nov 15) still had no reported MRI result or timeline as of Nov 22. New England is on its Week 11 bye, so Week 12 at the Chargers is the earliest he could return.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22. Earlier: Tate (shoulder) was limited in practice Nov 18-19 and reportedly is tracking toward a Week 11 return at Dallas after missing Weeks 8 and 10. He is still questionable, so check inactives before the 10 AM PT kickoff.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (hamstring) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22. Earlier: Thompson (hamstring) is doubtful for Week 11 vs. the Jets after not practicing early in the week and missing three straight games. A fourth straight absence is likely.

players.name: Drake London
players.note: London is still listed questionable for Week 11 as of Nov 22, and no injury details were found. Check Sunday inactives before kickoff.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.note: Aiyuk was reinstated Nov 9, and San Francisco's two-game roster exemption runs out Nov 23. Reports expect the 49ers to release him rather than add him to the 53-man roster.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: Samuel scored a TD on 44 of 65 snaps in his Nov 15 return. Mike Evans (Achilles tendinitis) was only a spectator early in the week and may not be ready for Week 11 vs. Minnesota, so Samuel's target share looks safe for now.

players.name: Jauan Jennings
players.note: Jennings (calf) came off the injury report Nov 18 after missing two games. With Jordan Addison out after thumb surgery, he is in line for more targets in Week 11.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Smith (hamstring) practiced fully Nov 19 and is off the injury report. He is set to return in Week 11 vs. Pittsburgh after missing three games.

players.name: Chris Bell
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (chest) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22. Earlier: Bell (knee) was off the injury report as of Nov 20 after missing Week 10 and appears set to return Sunday vs. Buffalo.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.note: Douglas (shoulder) is expected to play Sunday vs. Buffalo, but Chris Bell's return from a knee injury threatens his expanded role.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: Lane drew 11 targets Nov 16 vs. the Chargers (3-61) while Elijah Sarratt was a healthy scratch. He enters Week 11 ahead of Sarratt in Baltimore's rotation.

players.name: Elijah Sarratt
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22. Earlier: Sarratt was a coach's-decision inactive Nov 16 while Ja'Kobi Lane took an 11-target role, so his Week 11 role is in question.

players.name: Cyrus Allen
players.note: Allen played only 23 of 65 snaps Nov 15 in Josh Downs' Chiefs debut, though he caught a TD. Downs pushes him down the target pecking order.

players.name: Deion Burks
players.note: Burks started on TNF at Houston Nov 19 but did not catch any of his 3 targets. It was his second straight catchless game.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Adams (hamstring, IR) is targeting a return around Weeks 12-13, after the Rams' Week 11 bye.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: Pierce (heel) has been on IR since Week 3. On Nov 11, Shane Steichen said he was unsure whether Pierce will return in 2026.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: Addison (thumb) is out for Week 11 vs. San Francisco after thumb surgery, and he is expected to miss multiple weeks. As of Nov 20 the Vikings had not put him on IR.

players.name: Justin Jefferson
players.note: With Addison (thumb surgery) out for Week 11 and beyond, Jefferson keeps a heavy-volume WR1 role vs. San Francisco in Mexico City. Jauan Jennings is the next man up behind him.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22. Earlier: McConkey (back) is questionable after three limited practices and is a true game-time decision for Sunday vs. the Jets (Nov 22), coming off two missed games. He carries a real risk of leaving early even if he plays.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: McConkey (back) is questionable after three limited practices (Nov 20). If he sits, Harris keeps the key role he used for 5-86 on Nov 16. If McConkey plays, Harris's share likely shrinks.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.note: Aaron Glenn ruled Cooper (ankle/hip) out for Week 11 vs. the Chargers on Nov 20, after he missed every practice this week. It was his third ankle injury this year, and he could miss multiple weeks, which opens the No. 2 role for Adonai Mitchell.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: On Nov 20 McVay said Nacua had MCL surgery on Tuesday and will be out a couple of months. Asked whether that ends his regular season, McVay said 'you can pretty much say yes.' Nacua is also serving a three-game NFL suspension.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.note: Harrison (hamstring) missed the Nov 19 TNF game, his second straight absence, and has not practiced since before Week 9. Houston has a bye next, so his earliest return is Nov 29 vs. Baltimore.

players.name: Makai Lemon
players.note: DeVonta Smith practiced fully all week and is off the Eagles' injury report for Sunday vs. Pittsburgh, per Nov 20 reports. Lemon has drawn 27% of the team's targets over the past month as the fill-in WR1, so his volume likely dips.

players.name: Pat Bryant
players.note: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) is set to return in Week 11 after practicing fully following the bye, per Nov 20 reports. Bryant should still play a big role, but his target ceiling probably drops.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Branch (hamstring, Week 8) still had not been reported practicing as of Nov 20. Atlanta's Week 11 bye gives him extra time to recover.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: Hill is still unsigned and not yet medically cleared after his ACL tear. Agent Drew Rosenhaus says teams can sign him once he is cleared, and as of Nov 20 prediction markets list the Bills as favorites (44%).

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) remains on IR during New England's Week 11 bye. No return date had been reported as of Nov 20.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson is out for the season after fracturing his neck on Nov 8 vs. Seattle.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin is out for the 2026 season after tearing his left patellar tendon on Oct 19.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Evans (Achilles tendinitis) remains questionable for Sunday night's game vs. Minnesota in Mexico City (8:20 PM ET, Nov 22) after two limited practices. San Francisco may not announce his status until about 90 minutes before kickoff, and John Lynch said the team is 'extremely mindful' of his long-term health.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.note: Mike Evans (Achilles) is still a game-time call for Sunday night vs. Minnesota, and his status may not come until about 90 minutes before the 8:20 PM ET kickoff on Nov 22. If Evans sits, Allen stays a regular in the rotation after his 5-61 debut on Nov 15.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.note: The Steelers did not activate Pittman (foot) from IR on Saturday, Nov 21, so he will miss Week 11 at Philadelphia. His next chance to return is Week 12 vs. Denver.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22. Earlier: Pittsburgh activated Wilson from IR on Saturday, Nov 21, and he will play Sunday at Philadelphia. He had been out since Week 5 with finger fractures. With Pittman held on IR, Wilson steps into a larger role.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:16 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: Rodriguez (hand) was a limited practice participant again Wednesday, Nov. 18, and remains questionable for Jacksonville's Week 11 game. He has played through the hand issue before.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:16 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: Sleeper has listed Tuten questionable (ankle) since Nov. 18 ahead of Jacksonville's Week 11 game, and no practice update has been found yet. Friday's final designation will decide his availability.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:22 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: Tyson (chest) was limited at practice Nov 18 after an 11-catch game on Nov 15. No Thursday status had been reported as of Nov 20 for Sunday vs. Chicago.

players.name: Geno Smith
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:16 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: He was limited in practice on Wednesday and Thursday (Nov. 18-19) with a left-ankle injury. He says he plans to play, and the Jets believe he can start Sunday at the Chargers.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:16 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: Meyers was limited with an ankle injury Nov 18; he has played through the injury for several weeks. Jacksonville faces the Giants Sunday.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:16 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: Waddle (concussion) practiced fully Nov 18, and reports had him at full again Thursday, Nov 19. He is trending toward playing Nov 22 vs. Las Vegas, pending formal clearance from the protocol.

players.name: Isaiah Likely
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:16 PM PT Nov 20.

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
players.note: Sleeper now lists him on injured reserve (ankle) as of 3:17 PM PT Nov 21.

players.name: Jalen Coker
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (undisclosed) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.

players.name: Nicholas Singleton
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.

players.name: Drew Allar
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.

players.name: Adam Randall
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.

players.name: Skyler Bell
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.

players.name: Derrick Henry
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (concussion) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (knee) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.

players.name: Juwan Johnson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (hamstring) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.

players.name: Keaton Mitchell
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (back) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.
